title: Wall Mount Towel Shelve 3-Tier Hotel Style 24.7-Inch Brass Bathroom Shelf | Matte Black | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade bathroom organization with a wall mount towel shelve in a traditional bathroom hardware style in Matte Black, which makes a bold, modern statement with its sleek, non-reflective surface that anchors contemporary bathroom designs. This three-tier, hotel-style towel shelf (train rack style) adds vertical storage for folded towels and everyday bathroom essentials.

Highlights:
- Matte Black makes a bold, modern statement
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Brass construction for enduring use
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look
- Easy installation with mounting hardware included; some assembly required

Specs:
- Category: towel shelf / bathroom towel shelve
- Mounting type: wall mount
- Dimensions: 24.7 in length x 8.9 in width x 10.4 in height
- Projection: 3.5 in
- Product weight: 5.6 lb
- Included items: towel shelf arms (3), back plate, installation hardware
- Finish availability: multiple designer finish options including statement colors
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Great for coordinating classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures in traditional bathrooms.
